note: Presentation copy for openappco.com. Status never lives here: GitHub issue labels own it. Only apps submitted to Apple or live are published; what ships next is chosen day-of, privately (see _factory/open-suite/scripts/today.mjs).

apps.name: Open Piano
apps.tagline: A real piano. Labeled keys, a trail of every note, record and play back.

origin.quote: Pop up ads cover the whole screen whenever I play a note.

apps.name: Open Noise
apps.tagline: White, brown, and ocean noise with no timer limit.

origin.quote: This app literally needs you to pay or else you only have a five minute limit

apps.name: Open Tally
apps.tagline: A tally counter that opens ready to count.

origin.quote: Demands $13 every time I open the app.

apps.name: Open Metronome
apps.tagline: Steady time for practice. Nothing pops up over the beat.

origin.quote: I have this app for my kids to practice with. I just saw a porn add show up on it.

apps.name: Open Tuner
apps.tagline: Every instrument, every tuning, and it won't snap your strings.

origin.quote: it broke one of my strings becuase it kept telling me to tune up

apps.name: Open Fraction
apps.tagline: Keep the whole fraction. Four operators, reduction, a quiet keypad.

origin.quote: how is the addition function a Pro feature??

apps.name: Open Pressure
apps.tagline: Three numbers. Done. A blood pressure log your doctor can read.

origin.quote: I did an update to the app and it lost my profile and blood pressure history.

apps.name: Open Breath
apps.tagline: Box breathing at your own pace, with no paywall.

origin.quote: now you have to pay for a subscription to use it.

apps.name: Open Flashcards
apps.tagline: Make flashcards and study as much as you want. Decks stay on your phone and export as CSV.

origin.quote: Created hours of review material using the desktop version only to lose everything.

apps.name: Open Random
apps.tagline: Pick a number. A calm generator that opens ready.

origin.quote: Why are there ads in a random number generator of all things??

apps.name: Open Scan
apps.tagline: Point, scan, done. QR and barcodes with a short local history.

origin.quote: there’s no obvious easy to even scan without signing up.

apps.name: Open Tip
apps.tagline: Settle the table. Tip, tax, and split in one calm view.

origin.quote: Cannot tap on any of the predefined values

apps.name: Open Journal
apps.tagline: Write in plain Markdown. Your words, your phone, no lock-in.

origin.quote: losing 2 whole months of daily journal entry

apps.name: Open Magnifier
apps.tagline: Clarity, your way. A camera magnifier with a light and nothing else.

origin.quote: Doesn’t seem to use the cameras focus any longer.

apps.name: Open Feeds
apps.tagline: An RSS reader where read stays read. Your feed list is saved as a file an update can't wipe.

origin.quote: lost all of the feeds I had spent years curating

apps.name: Open Reader
apps.tagline: Your books stay files. Your page is saved on every turn.

origin.quote: it deleted every single book that I had downloaded and all my reading data

apps.name: Open Dice
apps.tagline: Just dice. Fair rolls and no ads in front of your kids.

origin.quote: lately the ads have contained inappropriate images to be used with children

apps.name: Open Beacon
apps.tagline: Find lost earbuds and hearing aids by feel, sound or sight.

origin.quote: The first thing that happens when you download it is it demands that you buy a membership/subscription for the app to even do its job.
